name: Rise
description:
RISE is a BEP-20 cryptocurrency token deployed on BNB Smart Chain, built using the OpenZeppelin ERC-20 standard.

The token has a fixed total supply of 4,000,000,000 RISE, with 18 decimals. Its smart contract source code is publicly verified on BscScan.

RISE is available for decentralized trading and swapping through its RISE/WBNB liquidity pool on PancakeSwap.

The project aims to improve token accessibility, transparency, and integration with supported cryptocurrency wallets and decentralized trading platforms.
